title: Integrative Multi-Omics and Experimental Validation Define RELB as an Immune-Related Prognostic Driver in Ovarian Cancer.
snippet: Ovarian cancer (OC) is one of the most aggressive gynecological malignancies worldwide. The tumor microenvironment and transcriptomic alterations play important roles in OC progression and therapeutic response. title: Genomic Landscape and Clinical Actionability of Skin Adnexal Carcinomas.
snippet: Skin adnexal carcinomas (SACs) are rare and heterogeneous tumors with no established systemic treatment options and poor long-term survival rates in the advanced disease setting. title: Medulloblastoma Spatial Transcriptomics Reveals Tumor Microenvironment Heterogeneity With High-Density Progenitor Cell Regions Correlating With High-Risk Disease.

title: Targeting the Tumor Microenvironment Network to Overcome Immunotherapy Resistance in Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer: Mechanisms to Clinical Translation.
